1→// This is your Prisma schema file,
     2→// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema
     3→
     4→generator client {
     5→  provider = "prisma-client-js"
     6→}
     7→
     8→datasource db {
     9→  provider  = "postgresql"
    10→  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
    11→  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED") // Direct connection for migrations (bypasses pooler)
    12→}
    13→
    14→/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
    15→model Package {
    16→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    17→
    18→  // NPM Metadata
    19→  npmPackageName String   @unique @map("npm_package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
    20→  npmVersion     String   @map("npm_version") @db.VarChar(50)
    21→  npmPublishedAt DateTime @map("npm_published_at")
    22→  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
    23→  npmRepository  Json?    @map("npm_repository") @db.JsonB
    24→  npmHomepage    String?  @map("npm_homepage") @db.Text
    25→  npmLicense     String?  @map("npm_license") @db.VarChar(50)
    26→  npmKeywords    String[] @default([]) @map("npm_keywords") @db.Text
    27→  npmReadme      String?  @map("npm_readme") @db.Text
    28→  npmAuthor      Json?    @map("npm_author") @db.JsonB
    29→  npmMaintainers Json?    @map("npm_maintainers") @db.JsonB
    30→
    31→  // TPMJS Package-Level Metadata
    32→  category       String   @db.VarChar(50)
    33→  env            Json?    @db.JsonB // Environment variables (shared across tools)
    34→  frameworks     String[] @default([]) @db.Text
    35→  tier           String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'minimal' | 'rich'
    36→  discoveryMethod String  @map("discovery_method") @db.VarChar(20) // 'keyword' | 'changes-feed'
    37→  isOfficial     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_official")
    38→
    39→  // Package Metrics
    40→  npmDownloadsLastMonth Int? @default(0) @map("npm_downloads_last_month")
    41→  githubStars           Int? @default(0) @map("github_stars")
    42→
    43→  // Timestamps
    44→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    45→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    46→
    47→  // Relations
    48→  tools Tool[]
    49→
    50→  @@index([category])
    51→  @@index([isOfficial])
    52→  @@index([npmDownloadsLastMonth])
    53→  @@index([createdAt])
    54→  @@map("packages")
    55→}
    56→
    57→/// Tool table - stores individual tools within packages
    58→model Tool {
    59→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    60→
    61→  // Package Relation
    62→  packageId String  @map("package_id")
    63→  package   Package @relation(fields: [packageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
    64→
    65→  // Tool Identity
    66→  name String @db.VarChar(100) // e.g., "helloWorldTool", "default"
    67→
    68→  // Tool Metadata
    69→  description String @db.Text
    70→  parameters  Json?  @db.JsonB // Legacy/fallback - author-provided parameters array
    71→  returns     Json?  @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    72→  aiAgent     Json?  @map("ai_agent") @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    73→
    74→  // Schema Extraction Fields
    75→  inputSchema                Json?     @map("input_schema") @db.JsonB // Full JSON Schema from executor
    76→  schemaSource               String?   @map("schema_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'extracted' | 'author' | null

1→// This is your Prisma schema file,

     4→generator client {
     5→  provider = "prisma-client-js"
     6→}

     9→  provider  = "postgresql"
    10→  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
    11→  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED") // Direct connection for migrations (bypasses pooler)
    12→}
    13→
    14→/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
    15→model Package {
    16→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    17→
    18→  // NPM Metadata
    19→  npmPackageName String   @unique @map("npm_package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
    20→  npmVersion     String   @map("npm_version") @db.VarChar(50)
    21→  npmPublishedAt DateTime @map("npm_published_at")
    22→  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
    23→  npmRepository  Json?    @map("npm_repository") @db.JsonB
    24→  npmHomepage    String?  @map("npm_homepage") @db.Text
    25→  npmLicense     String?  @map("npm_license") @db.VarChar(50)
    26→  npmKeywords    String[] @default([]) @map("npm_keywords") @db.Text
    27→  npmReadme      String?  @map("npm_readme") @db.Text
    28→  npmAuthor      Json?    @map("npm_author") @db.JsonB
    29→  npmMaintainers Json?    @map("npm_maintainers") @db.JsonB
    30→
    31→  // TPMJS Package-Level Metadata
    32→  category       String   @db.VarChar(50)
    33→  env            Json?    @db.JsonB // Environment variables (shared across tools)
    34→  frameworks     String[] @default([]) @db.Text
    35→  tier           String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'minimal' | 'rich'
    36→  discoveryMethod String  @map("discovery_method") @db.VarChar(20) // 'keyword' | 'changes-feed'
    37→  isOfficial     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_official")
    38→
    39→  // Package Metrics
    40→  npmDownloadsLastMonth Int? @default(0) @map("npm_downloads_last_month")
    41→  githubStars           Int? @default(0) @map("github_stars")
    42→
    43→  // Timestamps
    44→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    45→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    46→
    47→  // Relations
    48→  tools Tool[]
    49→
    50→  @@index([category])
    51→  @@index([isOfficial])
    52→  @@index([npmDownloadsLastMonth])
    53→  @@index([createdAt])
    54→  @@map("packages")
    55→}
    56→
    57→/// Tool table - stores individual tools within packages
    58→model Tool {
    59→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    60→
    61→  // Package Relation
    62→  packageId String  @map("package_id")
    63→  package   Package @relation(fields: [packageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
    64→
    65→  // Tool Identity
    66→  name String @db.VarChar(100) // e.g., "helloWorldTool", "default"
    67→
    68→  // Tool Metadata
    69→  description String @db.Text
    70→  parameters  Json?  @db.JsonB // Legacy/fallback - author-provided parameters array
    71→  returns     Json?  @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    72→  aiAgent     Json?  @map("ai_agent") @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    73→
    74→  // Schema Extraction Fields
    75→  inputSchema                Json?     @map("input_schema") @db.JsonB // Full JSON Schema from executor
    76→  schemaSource               String?   @map("schema_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'extracted' | 'author' | null
    77→  schemaExtractedAt          DateTime? @map("schema_extracted_at") // Only updated on successful extraction
    78→  schemaExtractionAttemptAt  DateTime? @map("schema_extraction_attempt_at") // Updated on every attempt (for rate limiting)
    79→  schemaExtractionError      String?   @map("schema_extraction_error") @db.Text // Error message from last failed attempt
    80→
    81→  // Tool Discovery Fields
    82→  toolDiscoverySource String? @map("tool_discovery_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'auto' | 'manual' | null
    83→
    84→  // Tool Metrics
    85→  qualityScore Decimal? @map("quality_score") @db.Decimal(3, 2) // 0.00 to 1.00
    86→  likeCount    Int      @default(0) @map("like_count")
    87→
    88→  // Health Status Fields
    89→  importHealth     HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("import_health")
    90→  executionHealth  HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("execution_health")
    91→  lastHealthCheck  DateTime?     @map("last_health_check")
    92→  healthCheckError String?       @map("health_check_error") @db.Text
    93→
    94→  // Timestamps
    95→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    96→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    97→
    98→  // View tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
    99→  viewCount    Int      @default(0) @map("view_count")
   100→
   101→  // Rating aggregates
   102→  averageRating Decimal? @map("average_rating") @db.Decimal(2, 1) // 1.0 to 5.0
   103→  ratingCount   Int      @default(0) @map("rating_count")

   105→
   106→  // Relations

   116→

   131→model SyncCheckpoint {

   164→  // Relations

   174→  // Results

   180→  // AI metadata

   184→  // Relations

   187→
   188→  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")

   190→
   191→  @@index([toolId])
   192→  @@index([status])

   201→  simulationId String     @unique @map("simulation_id")

  1518→
  1519→/// OmegaConversation - chat session for Omega AI agent

  1536→  // Timestamps

  1549→
  1550→/// OmegaMessage - individual message in an Omega conversation

  1581→
  1582→/// OmegaParticipant - tracks users in an Omega conversation

  1635→
  1636→/// OmegaUserSettings - user preferences for Omega
  1637→model OmegaUserSettings {
  1638→  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  1639→
  1640→  // User relationship
  1641→  userId             String   @unique @map("user_id")
  1642→
  1643→  // Tool preferences
  1644→  pinnedToolIds      String[] @default([]) @map("pinned_tool_ids")

  1647→  // Customization

  1657→  @@map("omega_user_settings")

  1659→
  1660→// ============================================================================
  1661→// RealSkills Models (Living Skills Endpoint - Question-Driven Evolution)
  1662→// ============================================================================
  1663→
  1664→/// SkillQuestion - Agent questions stored with embeddings for RAG
  1665→model SkillQuestion {
  1666→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1667→
  1668→  // Collection relationship
  1669→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1670→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1671→
  1672→  // Question content
  1673→  question     String     @db.Text
  1674→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1675→
  1676→  // Response
  1677→  answer       String     @db.Text
  1678→  answerTokens Int        @default(0) @map("answer_tokens")
  1679→
  1680→  // Agent identity (anonymized in UI)
  1681→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64) // Hash of IP + user-agent for deduplication
  1682→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100) // Self-reported agent name
  1683→  sessionId    String?    @map("session_id") // Optional session for multi-turn
  1684→
  1685→  // Metadata
  1686→  tags         String[]   @default([]) @db.Text
  1687→  confidence   Float      @default(0)
  1688→  similarCount Int        @default(0) @map("similar_count") // Times similar question asked
  1689→
  1690→  // Graph relationships
  1691→  skillNodes   SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1692→  toolNodes    SkillQuestionTool[]
  1693→
  1694→  // Timestamps
  1695→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1696→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1697→
  1698→  @@index([collectionId])
  1699→  @@index([sessionId])
  1700→  @@index([createdAt])
  1701→  @@map("skill_questions")
  1702→}
  1703→
  1704→/// Skill - Emergent skill nodes identified from question patterns
  1705→model Skill {
  1706→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1707→
  1708→  // Collection relationship
  1709→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1710→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1711→
  1712→  // Skill identity
  1713→  name         String     @db.VarChar(200) // e.g., "React useEffect debugging"
  1714→  slug         String     @db.VarChar(200) // URL-safe version
  1715→  description  String     @db.Text
  1716→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1717→
  1718→  // Stats
  1719→  questionCount Int       @default(0) @map("question_count")
  1720→  confidence    Float     @default(0) // Aggregate confidence
  1721→
  1722→  // Graph relationships
  1723→  questions     SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1724→  parentSkill   Skill?    @relation("SkillHierarchy", fields: [parentSkillId], references: [id])
  1725→  parentSkillId String?   @map("parent_skill_id")
  1726→  childSkills   Skill[]   @relation("SkillHierarchy")
  1727→
  1728→  // Timestamps
  1729→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  1731→
  1732→  @@unique([collectionId, slug])
  1733→  @@index([collectionId])
  1734→  @@index([questionCount])
  1735→  @@map("skills")
  1736→}
  1737→
  1738→/// SkillQuestionSkill - Junction table linking questions to skills
  1739→model SkillQuestionSkill {
  1740→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1741→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1742→  skillId    String        @map("skill_id")
  1743→  skill      Skill         @relation(fields: [skillId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1744→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1745→
  1746→  @@id([questionId, skillId])
  1747→  @@index([questionId])
  1748→  @@index([skillId])
  1749→  @@map("skill_question_skills")
  1750→}
  1751→
  1752→/// SkillQuestionTool - Junction table linking questions to tools mentioned
  1753→model SkillQuestionTool {
  1754→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1755→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1756→  toolId     String        @map("tool_id")
  1757→  tool       Tool          @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1758→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1759→
  1760→  @@id([questionId, toolId])
  1761→  @@index([questionId])
  1762→  @@index([toolId])
  1763→  @@map("skill_question_tools")
  1764→}
  1765→
  1766→/// SkillSession - Optional multi-turn conversation sessions
  1767→model SkillSession {
  1768→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1769→
  1770→  // Collection relationship
  1771→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1772→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1773→
  1774→  // Session state
  1775→  context      Json       @default("[]") @db.JsonB // Message history
  1776→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  1777→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1778→
  1779→  // Timestamps
  1780→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1781→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1782→  expiresAt    DateTime   @map("expires_at") // Auto-expire sessions
  1783→
  1784→  @@index([collectionId])
  1785→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1786→  @@map("skill_sessions")
  1787→}
  1788→
  1789→// ============================================================================
  1790→// Memory Models (Persistent Semantic Memory for AI Tool Collections)
  1791→// ============================================================================
  1792→
  1793→/// Memory - user-owned persistent memories for AI agents
  1794→model Memory {
  1795→  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  1796→
  1797→  // Owner relationship
  1798→  userId           String    @map("user_id")
  1799→  user             User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1800→
  1801→  // Content
  1802→  content          Json      @db.JsonB // Arbitrary JSON payload
  1803→  summary          String    @db.VarChar(500) // Auto-generated or user-provided preview
  1804→  namespace        String?   @db.VarChar(100) // Grouping like "project-x", "personal"
  1805→  tags             String[]  @default([]) @db.Text // Categorization tags
  1806→
  1807→  // Embedding for semantic search
  1808→  embedding        Json      @db.JsonB // 3072-dim float array (text-embedding-3-large)
  1809→
  1810→  // Provenance tracking
  1811→  source           String    @db.VarChar(100) // Which tool created it ("createMemoryTool", "dashboard")
  1812→  sourceAgent      String?   @map("source_agent") @db.VarChar(200) // Agent name/identifier
  1813→  sourceContext    Json?     @map("source_context") @db.JsonB // Additional creation context
  1814→
  1815→  // Size tracking
  1816→  contentSizeBytes Int       @map("content_size_bytes")
  1817→
  1818→  // TTL support
  1819→  expiresAt        DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  1820→
  1821→  // Timestamps
  1822→  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1823→  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1824→
  1825→  @@index([userId])
  1826→  @@index([userId, namespace])
  1827→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  1828→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1829→  @@map("memories")

Explore the codebase to understand how "collections" work in this TPMJS monorepo. Find:
1. The database schema for collections (in packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma)
2. Any API routes related to collections (in apps/web/src/app/api/)
3. Any UI pages/components for collections (in apps/web/src/app/dashboard/ or apps/web/src/components/)
4. How tools are added to collections currently
5. How tools relate to packages (package name grouping)

Be thorough - search for "collection" across the codebase.

1→import { z } from 'zod';
     2→
     3→import { ExecutorTypeSchema } from './executor';
     4→
     5→// Regex for valid collection names: letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, underscores
     6→const NAME_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\-_]+$/;
     7→
     8→// Executor config for updates (simplified schema that maps to database JSON)
     9→const ExecutorConfigUpdateSchema = z
    10→  .object({
    11→    url: z.string().url(),
    12→    apiKey: z.string().optional(),
    13→  })
    14→  .nullable()
    15→  .optional();
    16→
    17→// ============================================================================
    18→// Collection Schemas
    19→// ============================================================================
    20→
    21→export const CreateCollectionSchema = z.object({
    22→  name: z
    23→    .string()
    24→    .min(1, 'Name is required')
    25→    .max(100, 'Name must be 100 characters or less')
    26→    .regex(NAME_REGEX, 'Name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores'),
    27→  description: z.string().max(500, 'Description must be 500 characters or less').optional(),
    28→  isPublic: z.boolean().default(false),
    29→});
    30→
    31→export const UpdateCollectionSchema = z.object({
    32→  name: z
    33→    .string()
    34→    .min(1, 'Name is required')
    35→    .max(100, 'Name must be 100 characters or less')
    36→    .regex(NAME_REGEX, 'Name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores')
    37→    .optional(),
    38→  description: z
    39→    .string()
    40→    .max(500, 'Description must be 500 characters or less')
    41→    .nullable()
    42→    .optional(),
    43→  isPublic: z.boolean().optional(),
    44→  // Executor configuration
    45→  executorType: ExecutorTypeSchema.nullable().optional(),
    46→  executorConfig: ExecutorConfigUpdateSchema,

    48→  envVars: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).nullable().optional(),
    49→});
    50→
    51→// ============================================================================
    52→// Collection Tool Schemas
    53→// ============================================================================
    54→
    55→export const AddToolToCollectionSchema = z.object({
    56→  toolId: z.string().min(1, 'Tool ID is required'),
    57→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').optional(),
    58→  position: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
    59→});
    60→
    61→export const UpdateCollectionToolSchema = z.object({

    63→  position: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
    64→});
    65→
    66→export const ReorderToolsSchema = z.object({
    67→  toolIds: z.array(z.string().min(1)),
    68→});
    69→
    70→// ============================================================================
    71→// Bridge Tool Schemas
    72→// ============================================================================
    73→
    74→export const AddBridgeToolToCollectionSchema = z.object({
    75→  serverId: z.string().min(1, 'Server ID is required').max(100),
    76→  toolName: z.string().min(1, 'Tool name is required').max(100),
    77→  displayName: z.string().max(100).optional(),
    78→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').optional(),
    79→});
    80→
    81→export const UpdateCollectionBridgeToolSchema = z.object({
    82→  displayName: z.string().max(100).nullable().optional(),
    83→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').nullable().optional(),
    84→});
    85→
    86→// ============================================================================
    87→// Clone Schemas
    88→// ============================================================================
    89→
    90→export const CloneCollectionSchema = z.object({
    91→  name: z
    92→    .string()
    93→    .min(1, 'Name is required')
    94→    .max(100, 'Name must be 100 characters or less')
    95→    .regex(NAME_REGEX, 'Name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores')
    96→    .optional(), // If not provided, will use original name or append "(copy)"
    97→});
    98→
    99→// ============================================================================
   100→// Use Case Types (AI-generated workflows)
   101→// ============================================================================
   102→
   103→export const UseCaseToolStepSchema = z.object({
   104→  toolName: z.string().describe('Name of the tool being invoked'),
   105→  packageName: z.string().describe('NPM package name containing the tool'),
   106→  purpose: z.string().max(100).describe('Why this tool is called at this step'),
   107→  order: z.number().int().min(1).describe('Execution order (1-based)'),

   109→
   110→export const UseCaseSchema = z.object({
   111→  id: z.string().describe('Unique identifier for this use case'),

   113→    .string()
   114→    .min(20)
   115→    .max(200)
   116→    .describe('Example user prompt that triggers this workflow'),

   127→export type UseCaseToolStep = z.infer<typeof UseCaseToolStepSchema>;

   132→// Response Types (for API responses)
   133→// ============================================================================

   135→export const CollectionSchema = z.object({

   140→  isPublic: z.boolean(),

   143→  forkedFromId: z.string().nullable().optional(),

   145→  useCasesGeneratedAt: z.date().nullable().optional(),
   146→  createdAt: z.date(),
   147→  updatedAt: z.date(),
   148→});
   149→
   150→export const CollectionToolSchema = z.object({
   151→  id: z.string(),
   152→  toolId: z.string(),
   153→  position: z.number(),
   154→  note: z.string().nullable(),
   155→  addedAt: z.date(),
   156→  tool: z.object({

   158→    name: z.string(),
   159→    description: z.string(),

   163→      category: z.string(),
   164→    }),
   165→  }),
   166→});
   167→
   168→export const CollectionWithToolsSchema = CollectionSchema.extend({
   169→  tools: z.array(CollectionToolSchema),
   170→});
   171→
   172→// ============================================================================
   173→// Type Exports
   174→// ============================================================================
   175→
   176→export type CreateCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof CreateCollectionSchema>;
   177→export type UpdateCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof UpdateCollectionSchema>;
   178→export type AddToolToCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof AddToolToCollectionSchema>;
   179→export type UpdateCollectionToolInput = z.infer<typeof UpdateCollectionToolSchema>;
   180→export type ReorderToolsInput = z.infer<typeof ReorderToolsSchema>;
   181→export type CloneCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof CloneCollectionSchema>;

1→import { prisma } from '@tpmjs/db';
     2→import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
     3→import { checkRateLimit } from '~/lib/rate-limit';
     4→
     5→export const runtime = 'nodejs';
     6→export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
     7→export const maxDuration = 30;
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * GET /api/stats
    11→ * Comprehensive statistics about the TPMJS registry
    12→ *
    13→ * Returns complete developer-focused metrics including:
    14→ * - Registry totals (tools, packages, downloads)
    15→ * - Health status distribution
    16→ * - Quality score distribution
    17→ * - Category breakdown
    18→ * - Tier breakdown (minimal vs rich)
    19→ * - Recent activity
    20→ * - Execution statistics
    21→ * - Token usage statistics
    22→ * - Sync operation status
    23→ */
    24→export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
    25→  const startTime = Date.now();
    26→
    27→  // Check rate limit
    28→  const rateLimitResponse = checkRateLimit(request);
    29→  if (rateLimitResponse) {
    30→    return rateLimitResponse;
    31→  }
    32→
    33→  try {
    34→    // Time boundaries
    35→    const now = new Date();
    36→    const last24h = new Date(now.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    37→    const last7d = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    38→    const last30d = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    39→
    40→    // Run all aggregations in parallel for performance
    41→    const [
    42→      // Tool counts
    43→      totalTools,
    44→      officialToolCount,
    45→      toolsWithSchema,
    46→
    47→      // Health status counts
    48→      healthyImportCount,
    49→      brokenImportCount,
    50→      unknownImportCount,
    51→      healthyExecutionCount,
    52→      brokenExecutionCount,
    53→      unknownExecutionCount,
    54→
    55→      // Package data for aggregations
    56→      packages,
    57→
    58→      // Recent activity
    59→      toolsLast24h,
    60→      toolsLast7d,
    61→      toolsLast30d,
    62→      packagesLast7d,
    63→
    64→      // Simulation statistics
    65→      totalSimulations,
    66→      successfulSimulations,
    67→      failedSimulations,
    68→      simulationsLast24h,
    69→      simulationsLast7d,
    70→
    71→      // Execution time stats (successful simulations only)
    72→      executionTimeStats,
    73→
    74→      // Token usage aggregates
    75→      tokenUsageStats,
    76→
    77→      // Recent sync logs
    78→      recentSyncLogs,
    79→
    80→      // Sync checkpoints
    81→      syncCheckpoints,
    82→
    83→      // Health check history
    84→      healthChecksLast24h,
    85→      healthChecksLast7d,
    86→
    87→      // Quality score distribution
    88→      qualityScoreDistribution,
    89→    ] = await Promise.all([
    90→      // Total tools
    91→      prisma.tool.count(),
    92→
    93→      // Official tools
    94→      prisma.tool.count({
    95→        where: { package: { isOfficial: true } },
    96→      }),
    97→
    98→      // Tools with extracted schema
    99→      prisma.tool.count({
   100→        where: { schemaSource: 'extracted' },
   101→      }),
   102→
   103→      // Health status distribution - Import
   104→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { importHealth: 'HEALTHY' } }),
   105→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { importHealth: 'BROKEN' } }),
   106→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { importHealth: 'UNKNOWN' } }),
   107→
   108→      // Health status distribution - Execution
   109→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { executionHealth: 'HEALTHY' } }),
   110→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { executionHealth: 'BROKEN' } }),
   111→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { executionHealth: 'UNKNOWN' } }),
   112→
   113→      // Package data for category/tier/download aggregations
   114→      prisma.package.findMany({
   115→        select: {
   116→          category: true,
   117→          tier: true,
   118→          npmDownloadsLastMonth: true,
   119→          githubStars: true,
   120→          isOfficial: true,
   121→          _count: { select: { tools: true } },
   122→        },
   123→      }),
   124→
   125→      // Recent tools
   126→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last24h } } }),
   127→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last7d } } }),
   128→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last30d } } }),
   129→      prisma.package.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last7d } } }),
   130→
   131→      // Simulation counts
   132→      prisma.simulation.count(),
   133→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: 'success' } }),
   134→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: { in: ['error', 'timeout'] } } }),
   135→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last24h } } }),
   136→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last7d } } }),
   137→
   138→      // Execution time statistics (only for successful simulations with timing data)
   139→      prisma.simulation.aggregate({
   140→        where: {
   141→          status: 'success',
   142→          executionTimeMs: { not: null },
   143→        },
   144→        _avg: { executionTimeMs: true },
   145→        _min: { executionTimeMs: true },
   146→        _max: { executionTimeMs: true },
   147→      }),
   148→
   149→      // Token usage aggregates
   150→      prisma.tokenUsage.aggregate({
   151→        _sum: {
   152→          inputTokens: true,
   153→          outputTokens: true,
   154→          totalTokens: true,
   155→          estimatedCost: true,
   156→        },
   157→        _avg: {
   158→          totalTokens: true,
   159→          estimatedCost: true,
   160→        },
   161→        _count: true,
   162→      }),
   163→
   164→      // Recent sync logs (last 10)
   165→      prisma.syncLog.findMany({
   166→        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
   167→        take: 10,
   168→        select: {
   169→          source: true,

1→import { prisma } from '@tpmjs/db';
     2→import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
     3→
     4→export const runtime = 'nodejs';
     5→export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
     6→export const maxDuration = 60;
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * POST /api/sync/stats-snapshot
    10→ * Captures a daily snapshot of registry statistics for historical tracking.
    11→ * Should be run once per day via cron.
    12→ */
    13→// biome-ignore lint/complexity/noExcessiveCognitiveComplexity: cron handler with many parallel queries
    14→export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
    15→  const startTime = Date.now();
    16→
    17→  // Verify cron secret
    18→  const authHeader = request.headers.get('authorization');
    19→  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
    20→
    21→  if (cronSecret && authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    22→    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  try {
    26→    // Get today's date at midnight UTC
    27→    const today = new Date();
    28→    today.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    29→
    30→    // Check if we already have a snapshot for today
    31→    const existingSnapshot = await prisma.statsSnapshot.findUnique({
    32→      where: { date: today },
    33→    });
    34→
    35→    if (existingSnapshot) {
    36→      return NextResponse.json({
    37→        success: true,
    38→        message: 'Snapshot already exists for today',
    39→        data: { date: today.toISOString(), id: existingSnapshot.id },
    40→      });
    41→    }
    42→
    43→    // Time boundaries for daily counts
    44→    const yesterday = new Date(today);
    45→    yesterday.setDate(yesterday.getDate() - 1);
    46→
    47→    // Gather all statistics in parallel
    48→    const [
    49→      // Tool and package counts
    50→      totalTools,
    51→      totalPackages,
    52→      officialTools,
    53→      officialPackages,
    54→      toolsWithSchema,
    55→
    56→      // Health status counts
    57→      importHealthy,
    58→      importBroken,
    59→      importUnknown,
    60→      executionHealthy,
    61→      executionBroken,
    62→      executionUnknown,
    63→
    64→      // Package data for aggregations
    65→      packages,
    66→
    67→      // Daily execution stats
    68→      dailyExecutions,
    69→      dailySuccessful,
    70→      dailyFailed,
    71→      avgExecutionTime,
    72→
    73→      // Daily token usage
    74→      dailyTokens,
    75→
    76→      // Daily health checks
    77→      dailyHealthChecks,
    78→
    79→      // Social proof
    80→      activeDevsResult,
    81→      publicCollectionsCount,
    82→      publicAgentsCount,
    83→      totalSimulationsCount,
    84→
    85→      // Quality distribution
    86→      qualityDistribution,
    87→    ] = await Promise.all([
    88→      // Tool counts
    89→      prisma.tool.count(),
    90→      prisma.package.count(),
    91→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { package: { isOfficial: true } } }),
    92→      prisma.package.count({ where: { isOfficial: true } }),
    93→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { schemaSource: 'extracted' } }),
    94→
    95→      // Health status
    96→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { importHealth: 'HEALTHY' } }),
    97→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { importHealth: 'BROKEN' } }),
    98→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { importHealth: 'UNKNOWN' } }),
    99→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { executionHealth: 'HEALTHY' } }),
   100→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { executionHealth: 'BROKEN' } }),
   101→      prisma.tool.count({ where: { executionHealth: 'UNKNOWN' } }),
   102→
   103→      // Package data
   104→      prisma.package.findMany({
   105→        select: {
   106→          tier: true,
   107→          category: true,
   108→          npmDownloadsLastMonth: true,
   109→          githubStars: true,
   110→          _count: { select: { tools: true } },
   111→        },
   112→      }),
   113→
   114→      // Daily execution stats
   115→      prisma.simulation.count({
   116→        where: { createdAt: { gte: yesterday, lt: today } },
   117→      }),
   118→      prisma.simulation.count({
   119→        where: { createdAt: { gte: yesterday, lt: today }, status: 'success' },
   120→      }),
   121→      prisma.simulation.count({
   122→        where: {
   123→          createdAt: { gte: yesterday, lt: today },
   124→          status: { in: ['error', 'timeout'] },
   125→        },
   126→      }),
   127→      prisma.simulation.aggregate({
   128→        where: {
   129→          createdAt: { gte: yesterday, lt: today },
   130→          status: 'success',
   131→          executionTimeMs: { not: null },
   132→        },
   133→        _avg: { executionTimeMs: true },
   134→      }),
   135→
   136→      // Daily token usage
   137→      prisma.tokenUsage.aggregate({
   138→        where: { createdAt: { gte: yesterday, lt: today } },
   139→        _sum: {
   140→          inputTokens: true,
   141→          outputTokens: true,
   142→          totalTokens: true,
   143→          estimatedCost: true,
   144→        },
   145→      }),
   146→
   147→      // Daily health checks
   148→      prisma.healthCheck.count({
   149→        where: { createdAt: { gte: yesterday, lt: today } },
   150→      }),
   151→
   152→      // Social proof fields
   153→      prisma.userActivity.groupBy({
   154→        by: ['userId'],
   155→        where: {
   156→          createdAt: { gte: new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) },
   157→        },
   158→      }),
   159→      prisma.collection.count({ where: { isPublic: true } }),
   160→      prisma.agent.count({ where: { isPublic: true } }),
   161→      prisma.simulation.count(),
   162→
   163→      // Quality score distribution
   164→      prisma.$queryRaw<{ bucket: string; count: bigint }[]>`
   165→        SELECT
   166→          CASE
   167→            WHEN quality_score IS NULL THEN 'unscored'
   168→            WHEN quality_score < 0.3 THEN 'low'
   169→            WHEN quality_score < 0.5 THEN 'medium-low'
   170→            WHEN quality_score < 0.7 THEN 'medium'
   171→            WHEN quality_score < 0.9 THEN 'high'
   172→            ELSE 'excellent'
   173→          END as bucket,
   174→          COUNT(*) as count
   175→        FROM tools
   176→        GROUP BY
   177→          CASE
   178→            WHEN quality_score IS NULL THEN 'unscored'
   179→            WHEN quality_score < 0.3 THEN 'low'
   180→            WHEN quality_score < 0.5 THEN 'medium-low'
   181→            WHEN quality_score < 0.7 THEN 'medium'
   182→            WHEN quality_score < 0.9 THEN 'high'
   183→            ELSE 'excellent'
   184→          END
   185→      `,
   186→    ]);
   187→
   188→    // Aggregate package data
   189→    let tiersMinimal = 0;
   190→    let tiersRich = 0;
   191→    let totalNpmDownloads = 0;
   192→    let totalGithubStars = 0;
   193→    const categories: Record<string, number> = {};
   194→
   195→    for (const pkg of packages) {
   196→      if (pkg.tier === 'minimal') tiersMinimal++;
   197→      if (pkg.tier === 'rich') tiersRich++;
   198→      totalNpmDownloads += pkg.npmDownloadsLastMonth || 0;
   199→      totalGithubStars += pkg.githubStars || 0;
   200→
   201→      if (pkg.category) {
   202→        categories[pkg.category] = (categories[pkg.category] || 0) + pkg._count.tools;
   203→      }
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    // Format quality distribution
   207→    const qualityDist: Record<string, number> = {};
   208→    for (const row of qualityDistribution) {
   209→      qualityDist[row.bucket] = Number(row.count);
   210→    }
   211→
   212→    // Create the snapshot
   213→    const snapshot = await prisma.statsSnapshot.create({
   214→      data: {
   215→        date: today,
   216→
   217→        // Registry overview
   218→        totalTools,
   219→        totalPackages,
   220→        officialTools,
   221→        officialPackages,
   222→        toolsWithSchema,
   223→
   224→        // Downloads & stars
   225→        totalNpmDownloads,
   226→        totalGithubStars,
   227→
   228→        // Health status
   229→        importHealthy,
   230→        importBroken,
   231→        importUnknown,
   232→        executionHealthy,
   233→        executionBroken,
   234→        executionUnknown,
   235→
   236→        // Quality distribution
   237→        qualityDistribution: qualityDist,
   238→
   239→        // Tiers
   240→        tiersMinimal,
   241→        tiersRich,
   242→
   243→        // Daily execution stats
   244→        executionsTotal: dailyExecutions,
   245→        executionsSuccessful: dailySuccessful,
   246→        executionsFailed: dailyFailed,
   247→        executionsAvgTimeMs: avgExecutionTime._avg.executionTimeMs
   248→          ? Math.round(avgExecutionTime._avg.executionTimeMs)
   249→          : null,
   250→
   251→        // Daily token usage
   252→        tokensInput: BigInt(dailyTokens._sum.inputTokens || 0),
   253→        tokensOutput: BigInt(dailyTokens._sum.outputTokens || 0),
   254→        tokensTotal: BigInt(dailyTokens._sum.totalTokens || 0),
   255→        tokensCostUsd: dailyTokens._sum.estimatedCost,
   256→
   257→        // Daily health checks
   258→        healthChecksRun: dailyHealthChecks,
   259→
   260→        // Categories
   261→        categories,
   262→
   263→        // Social proof
   264→        activeDevs7d: activeDevsResult.length,
   265→        totalCollections: publicCollectionsCount,
   266→        totalAgents: publicAgentsCount,
   267→        totalSimulations: totalSimulationsCount,
   268→      },
   269→    });
   270→
   271→    const processingTime = Date.now() - startTime;
   272→
   273→    return NextResponse.json({
   274→      success: true,
   275→      data: {
   276→        id: snapshot.id,
   277→        date: snapshot.date,
   278→        totalTools: snapshot.totalTools,
   279→        totalPackages: snapshot.totalPackages,
   280→        executionsTotal: snapshot.executionsTotal,
   281→        processingTimeMs: processingTime,
   282→      },
   283→    });
   284→  } catch (error) {
   285→    console.error('Error creating stats snapshot:', error);
   286→
   287→    return NextResponse.json(
   288→      {
   289→        success: false,
   290→        error: {
   291→          code: 'SNAPSHOT_ERROR',
   292→          message: 'Failed to create stats snapshot',
   293→          details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
   294→        },
   295→      },
   296→      { status: 500 }
   297→    );
   298→  }
   299→}
   300→
   301→// GET endpoint to retrieve recent snapshots
   302→export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   303→  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
   304→  const days = Math.min(parseInt(searchParams.get('days') || '30', 10), 365);
   305→
   306→  try {
   307→    const since = new Date();
   308→    since.setDate(since.getDate() - days);
   309→
   310→    const snapshots = await prisma.statsSnapshot.findMany({
   311→      where: { date: { gte: since } },
   312→      orderBy: { date: 'asc' },
   313→    });
   314→
   315→    // Convert BigInt to number for JSON serialization
   316→    const serializedSnapshots = snapshots.map((s) => ({
   317→      ...s,
   318→      tokensInput: Number(s.tokensInput),
   319→      tokensOutput: Number(s.tokensOutput),
   320→      tokensTotal: Number(s.tokensTotal),
   321→    }));
   322→
   323→    return NextResponse.json({
   324→      success: true,
   325→      data: {
   326→        snapshots: serializedSnapshots,
   327→        count: snapshots.length,
   328→        days,
   329→      },
   330→    });
   331→  } catch (error) {
   332→    console.error('Error fetching stats snapshots:', error);
   333→
   334→    return NextResponse.json(
   335→      {
   336→        success: false,
   337→        error: {
   338→          code: 'FETCH_ERROR',
   339→          message: 'Failed to fetch stats snapshots',
   340→          details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error',
   341→        },
   342→      },
   343→      { status: 500 }
   344→    );
   345→  }
   346→}

1→import { prisma } from '@tpmjs/db';
     2→import { type NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
     3→import { checkRateLimit } from '~/lib/rate-limit';
     4→
     5→export const runtime = 'nodejs';
     6→export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
     7→export const maxDuration = 30;
     8→
     9→/**
    10→ * GET /api/stats/executions
    11→ * Detailed execution (simulation) statistics and analytics
    12→ *
    13→ * Returns:
    14→ * - Execution counts and success rates
    15→ * - Performance timing metrics
    16→ * - Token usage analytics
    17→ * - Most executed tools
    18→ * - Execution trends over time
    19→ * - Error analysis
    20→ */
    21→export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
    22→  const startTime = Date.now();
    23→
    24→  // Check rate limit
    25→  const rateLimitResponse = checkRateLimit(request);
    26→  if (rateLimitResponse) {
    27→    return rateLimitResponse;
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  try {
    31→    const now = new Date();
    32→    const last1h = new Date(now.getTime() - 60 * 60 * 1000);
    33→    const last24h = new Date(now.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    34→    const last7d = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    35→    const last30d = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    36→
    37→    const [
    38→      // Total counts
    39→      totalExecutions,
    40→      successCount,
    41→      errorCount,
    42→      timeoutCount,
    43→      pendingCount,
    44→      runningCount,
    45→
    46→      // Time-based counts
    47→      execLast1h,
    48→      execLast24h,
    49→      execLast7d,
    50→      execLast30d,
    51→
    52→      // Timing statistics
    53→      timingStats,
    54→
    55→      // Token usage aggregates
    56→      tokenStats,
    57→
    58→      // Most executed tools
    59→      mostExecutedTools,
    60→
    61→      // Recent executions
    62→      recentExecutions,
    63→
    64→      // Execution by status (last 24h)
    65→      statusBreakdown24h,
    66→
    67→      // Hourly trends (last 24h)
    68→      hourlyTrends,
    69→
    70→      // Daily trends (last 7 days)
    71→      dailyTrends,
    72→
    73→      // Top errors
    74→      topErrors,
    75→
    76→      // Model usage breakdown
    77→      modelUsage,
    78→    ] = await Promise.all([
    79→      // Total counts
    80→      prisma.simulation.count(),
    81→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: 'success' } }),
    82→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: 'error' } }),
    83→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: 'timeout' } }),
    84→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: 'pending' } }),
    85→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { status: 'running' } }),
    86→
    87→      // Time-based counts
    88→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last1h } } }),
    89→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last24h } } }),
    90→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last7d } } }),
    91→      prisma.simulation.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: last30d } } }),
    92→
    93→      // Timing stats for successful executions
    94→      prisma.simulation.aggregate({
    95→        where: {
    96→          status: 'success',
    97→          executionTimeMs: { not: null },
    98→        },
    99→        _avg: { executionTimeMs: true, agentSteps: true },
   100→        _min: { executionTimeMs: true },
   101→        _max: { executionTimeMs: true },
   102→        _count: true,
   103→      }),
   104→
   105→      // Token usage stats
   106→      prisma.tokenUsage.aggregate({
   107→        _sum: {
   108→          inputTokens: true,
   109→          outputTokens: true,
   110→          totalTokens: true,
   111→          estimatedCost: true,
   112→        },
   113→        _avg: {
   114→          inputTokens: true,
   115→          outputTokens: true,
   116→          totalTokens: true,
   117→          estimatedCost: true,
   118→        },
   119→        _min: { totalTokens: true },
   120→        _max: { totalTokens: true },
   121→        _count: true,
   122→      }),
   123→
   124→      // Most executed tools (top 20)
   125→      prisma.simulation.groupBy({
   126→        by: ['toolId'],
   127→        _count: { id: true },
   128→        orderBy: { _count: { id: 'desc' } },
   129→        take: 20,
   130→      }),
   131→
   132→      // Recent executions (last 20)
   133→      prisma.simulation.findMany({
   134→        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
   135→        take: 20,
   136→        select: {
   137→          id: true,
   138→          status: true,
   139→          executionTimeMs: true,
   140→          agentSteps: true,
   141→          model: true,
   142→          createdAt: true,
   143→          completedAt: true,
   144→          tool: {
   145→            select: {
   146→              name: true,
   147→              package: { select: { npmPackageName: true } },
   148→            },
   149→          },
   150→          tokenUsage: {
   151→            select: {
   152→              totalTokens: true,
   153→              estimatedCost: true,
   154→            },
   155→          },
   156→        },
   157→      }),
   158→
   159→      // Status breakdown last 24h
   160→      prisma.simulation.groupBy({
   161→        by: ['status'],
   162→        where: { createdAt: { gte: last24h } },
   163→        _count: { id: true },
   164→      }),
   165→
   166→      // Hourly trends (last 24h)
   167→      prisma.$queryRaw<
   168→        {
   169→          hour: Date;
   170→          total: bigint;
   171→          success: bigint;
   172→          error: bigint;
   173→        }[]
   174→      >`
   175→        SELECT
   176→          DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at) as hour,
   177→          COUNT(*) as total,
   178→          SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success,
   179→          SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('error', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as error
   180→        FROM simulations
   181→        WHERE created_at >= ${last24h}
   182→        GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', created_at)
   183→        ORDER BY hour DESC
   184→      `,
   185→
   186→      // Daily trends (last 7 days)
   187→      prisma.$queryRaw<
   188→        {
   189→          date: Date;
   190→          total: bigint;
   191→          success: bigint;
   192→          error: bigint;
   193→          avg_time_ms: number | null;
   194→        }[]
   195→      >`
   196→        SELECT
   197→          DATE(created_at) as date,
   198→          COUNT(*) as total,
   199→          SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success,
   200→          SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('error', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as error,
   201→          AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN execution_time_ms END) as avg_time_ms
   202→        FROM simulations
   203→        WHERE created_at >= ${last7d}
   204→        GROUP BY DATE(created_at)
   205→        ORDER BY date DESC
   206→      `,
   207→
   208→      // Top errors (most common error messages)
   209→      prisma.$queryRaw<{ error: string; count: bigint }[]>`
   210→        SELECT
   211→          SUBSTRING(error, 1, 200) as error,
   212→          COUNT(*) as count
   213→        FROM simulations
   214→        WHERE status IN ('error', 'timeout')
   215→          AND error IS NOT NULL
   216→          AND created_at >= ${last7d}
   217→        GROUP BY SUBSTRING(error, 1, 200)
   218→        ORDER BY count DESC
   219→        LIMIT 10
   220→      `,
   221→
   222→      // Model usage breakdown
   223→      prisma.simulation.groupBy({
   224→        by: ['model'],
   225→        where: { model: { not: null } },
   226→        _count: { id: true },
   227→        orderBy: { _count: { id: 'desc' } },
   228→      }),
   229→    ]);
   230→
   231→    // Get tool details for most executed
   232→    const toolIds = mostExecutedTools.map((t) => t.toolId);
   233→    const toolDetails = await prisma.tool.findMany({
   234→      where: { id: { in: toolIds } },
   235→      select: {
   236→        id: true,
   237→        name: true,
   238→        package: { select: { npmPackageName: true } },
   239→      },
   240→    });
   241→    const toolMap = new Map(toolDetails.map((t) => [t.id, t]));
   242→
   243→    // Format most executed tools
   244→    const formattedMostExecuted = mostExecutedTools.map((item) => {
   245→      const tool = toolMap.get(item.toolId);
   246→      return {
   247→        toolId: item.toolId,
   248→        packageName: tool?.package.npmPackageName ?? 'unknown',
   249→        toolName: tool?.name ?? 'unknown',
   250→        executionCount: item._count.id,
   251→      };
   252→    });
   253→
   254→    // Calculate success rate
   255→    const completedCount = successCount + errorCount + timeoutCount;
   256→    const successRate =
   257→      completedCount > 0 ? ((successCount / completedCount) * 100).toFixed(2) : '0.00';
   258→
   259→    // Format status breakdown
   260→    const statusBreakdownMap: Record<string, number> = {};
   261→    for (const item of statusBreakdown24h) {
   262→      statusBreakdownMap[item.status] = item._count.id;
   263→    }
   264→
   265→    // Format hourly trends
   266→    const formattedHourlyTrends = hourlyTrends.map((h) => ({
   267→      hour: h.hour,
   268→      total: Number(h.total),
   269→      success: Number(h.success),
   270→      error: Number(h.error),
   271→      successRate:
   272→        Number(h.total) > 0 ? ((Number(h.success) / Number(h.total)) * 100).toFixed(2) : '0.00',
   273→    }));
   274→
   275→    // Format daily trends
   276→    const formattedDailyTrends = dailyTrends.map((d) => ({
   277→      date: d.date,
   278→      total: Number(d.total),
   279→      success: Number(d.success),
   280→      error: Number(d.error),
   281→      avgTimeMs: d.avg_time_ms ? Math.round(d.avg_time_ms) : null,
   282→      successRate:
   283→        Number(d.total) > 0 ? ((Number(d.success) / Number(d.total)) * 100).toFixed(2) : '0.00',
   284→    }));
   285→
   286→    // Format recent executions
   287→    const formattedRecentExecutions = recentExecutions.map((exec) => ({
   288→      id: exec.id,
   289→      packageName: exec.tool.package.npmPackageName,
   290→      toolName: exec.tool.name,
   291→      status: exec.status,
   292→      executionTimeMs: exec.executionTimeMs,
   293→      agentSteps: exec.agentSteps,
   294→      model: exec.model,
   295→      tokens: exec.tokenUsage?.totalTokens ?? null,
   296→      costUsd: exec.tokenUsage?.estimatedCost
   297→        ? Number(exec.tokenUsage.estimatedCost).toFixed(6)
   298→        : null,
   299→      createdAt: exec.createdAt,
   300→      completedAt: exec.completedAt,
   301→    }));
   302→
   303→    // Format top errors
   304→    const formattedErrors = topErrors.map((e) => ({
   305→      error: e.error,
   306→      count: Number(e.count),
   307→    }));
   308→
   309→    // Format model usage
   310→    const formattedModelUsage = modelUsage.map((m) => ({
   311→      model: m.model,
   312→      count: m._count.id,
   313→    }));
   314→
   315→    const processingTime = Date.now() - startTime;
   316→
   317→    return NextResponse.json(
   318→      {
   319→        success: true,
   320→        meta: {
   321→          version: '1.0.0',
   322→          timestamp: now.toISOString(),
   323→          processingTimeMs: processingTime,
   324→        },
   325→        data: {
   326→          // Overview
   327→          overview: {
   328→            totalExecutions,
   329→            successRate: `${successRate}%`,
   330→            byStatus: {
   331→              success: successCount,
   332→              error: errorCount,
   333→              timeout: timeoutCount,
   334→              pending: pendingCount,
   335→              running: runningCount,
   336→            },
   337→          },
   338→
   339→          // Activity
   340→          activity: {
   341→            last1h: execLast1h,
   342→            last24h: execLast24h,

   346→          },
   347→
   348→          // Performance
   349→          performance: {

   355→              maxMs: timingStats._max.executionTimeMs,

   360→              : null,

   362→
   363→          // Token usage
   364→          tokens: {

   394→          // Model usage

1→import type { ActivityType, Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
     2→import { prisma } from '@tpmjs/db';
     3→
     4→export interface LogActivityParams {
     5→  userId: string;
     6→  type: ActivityType;
     7→  targetName: string;
     8→  targetType: 'agent' | 'collection' | 'tool';
     9→  agentId?: string;
    10→  collectionId?: string;
    11→  toolId?: string;
    12→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * Log user activity (fire-and-forget pattern)
    17→ * Never throws - failures are logged but don't break the main operation
    18→ */
    19→export async function logActivity(params: LogActivityParams): Promise<void> {
    20→  try {
    21→    await prisma.userActivity.create({
    22→      data: {
    23→        userId: params.userId,
    24→        type: params.type,
    25→        targetName: params.targetName,
    26→        targetType: params.targetType,
    27→        agentId: params.agentId,
    28→        collectionId: params.collectionId,
    29→        toolId: params.toolId,
    30→        metadata: params.metadata as Prisma.InputJsonValue | undefined,
    31→      },
    32→    });
    33→  } catch (error) {
    34→    // Never throw - activity logging should never break main operations
    35→    console.error('Failed to log activity:', error);
    36→  }
    37→}
    38→
    39→/**
    40→ * Activity type to human-readable message mapping
    41→ */
    42→export const ACTIVITY_MESSAGES: Record<
    43→  ActivityType,
    44→  (targetName: string, metadata?: Record<string, unknown>) => string

    46→  AGENT_CREATED: (name) => `Created agent "${name}"`,

    51→    meta?.sourceAgentName

    53→      : `Forked agent as "${name}"`,
    54→  AGENT_TOOL_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    55→    meta?.toolName
    56→      ? `Added tool "${meta.toolName}" to agent "${name}"`
    57→      : `Added tool to agent "${name}"`,
    58→  AGENT_TOOL_REMOVED: (name, meta) =>
    59→    meta?.toolName
    60→      ? `Removed tool "${meta.toolName}" from agent "${name}"`
    61→      : `Removed tool from agent "${name}"`,
    62→  AGENT_COLLECTION_ADDED: (name, meta) =>
    63→    meta?.collectionName
    64→      ? `Added collection "${meta.collectionName}" to agent "${name}"`
    65→      : `Added collection to agent "${name}"`,
    66→  AGENT_COLLECTION_REMOVED: (name, meta) =>
    67→    meta?.collectionName

    70→  COLLECTION_CREATED: (name) => `Created collection "${name}"`,

    72→  COLLECTION_DELETED: (name) => `Deleted collection "${name}"`,

    78→  COLLECTION_TOOL_ADDED: (name, meta) =>

    81→      : `Added tool to collection "${name}"`,
    82→  COLLECTION_TOOL_REMOVED: (name, meta) =>

    92→};
    93→

## Collections in TPMJS Monorepo - Comprehensive Analysis

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's a complete understanding of how collections work:

### 1. Database Schema for Collections

**Location**: `/packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` (lines 451-551)

Collections are composed of three key database models:

#### **Collection Model** (lines 456-525)
- **Core Fields**:
  - `id`: Unique identifier (CUID)
  - `userId`: Owner relationship (required)
  - `name`: Display name (100 chars max)
  - `slug`: URL-friendly identifier (nullable, 50 chars, unique per user)
  - `description`: Optional (500 chars max)
  - `isPublic`: Visibility flag (defaults to false)

- **Metrics & Tracking**:
  - `likeCount`: Number of likes (denormalized)
  - `viewCount`: Page views (rolled up daily)

- **Executor Configuration** (for tool execution):
  - `executorType`: Which executor to use (e.g., "railway", "vercel")
  - `executorConfig`: JSON configuration with `url` and optional `apiKey`

- **Environment Variables**:
  - `envVars`: Encrypted JSON object of env vars passed to tools at runtime
  - Overridable at collection and agent level

- **AI-Generated Content**:
  - `useCases`: AI-generated use cases (JSON array)
  - `useCasesGeneratedAt`: Timestamp of generation
  - `skillsMarkdown`: AI-generated skills documentation
  - `skillsSeeded`: RealSkills lazy loading state

- **Fork Tracking**:
  - `forkedFromId`: Reference to original collection (for "fork to use" pattern)
  - `forkCount`: Number of forks from this collection

- **Relations**:
  - `tools`: CollectionTool[] (many-to-many)
  - `agents`: AgentCollection[] (many-to-many)
  - `likes`: CollectionLike[] (users who liked)
  - `scenarios`: Scenario[] (test scenarios)
  - `skillsGenerationJobs`: SkillsGenerationJob[] (progress tracking)
  - `skillQuestions`: SkillQuestion[] (RAG for RealSkills)
  - `skills`: Skill[] (emergent skill nodes)

#### **CollectionTool Model** (lines 528-551)
Junction table for many-to-many relationship between collections and tools:
- `collectionId` & `toolId`: Foreign keys
- `position`: Ordering of tools within collection
- `note`: Optional user notes (500 chars)
- `addedAt`: Timestamp when tool was added
- **Unique Constraint**: Tool can only appear once per collection

#### **CollectionBridgeTool Model** (lines 1012-1034)
For MCP bridge tools (real-time tools from Claude desktop):
- `serverId`: Bridge server identifier (e.g., "chrome-devtools")
- `toolName`: Tool name within the server
- `displayName`: Optional override for display
- `note`: User notes

### 2. Type Definitions

**Location**: `/packages/types/src/collection.ts`

Zod schemas and types for:
- **CreateCollectionSchema**: name, description, isPublic
- **UpdateCollectionSchema**: name, description, isPublic, executorType, executorConfig, envVars
- **AddToolToCollectionSchema**: toolId, note (optional), position (optional)
- **UpdateCollectionToolSchema**: note, position
- **CloneCollectionSchema**: name override on clone
- **AddBridgeToolToCollectionSchema**: serverId, toolName, displayName, note

**Constants**:
```typescript
MAX_COLLECTIONS_PER_USER: 50
MAX_TOOLS_PER_COLLECTION: 100
MAX_BRIDGE_TOOLS_PER_COLLECTION: 50
```

### 3. API Routes for Collections

**Location**: `/apps/web/src/app/api/collections/`

#### **GET /api/collections** (list user collections)
- Requires authentication (API key or session)
- Pagination: `limit` (1-50, default 20), `offset` (default 0)
- Search: `search` parameter (case-insensitive on name & description)
- Uses `take: limit + 1` technique for pagination (avoids expensive `count()`)
- Returns collection count of tools via `_count.tools`

#### **POST /api/collections** (create)
- Creates collection with unique slug per user
- Auto-likes collection (starts with likeCount: 1)
- Validates unique name per user (case-insensitive)
- Enforces max 50 collections per user
- Logs `COLLECTION_CREATED` activity

#### **GET /api/collections/[id]/tools** (list tools in collection)
- Public collections: anyone can read
- Private collections: owner only
- Returns CollectionTool records with tool details
- Orders by position

#### **POST /api/collections/[id]/tools** (add tool)
- Ownership check: user must own collection
- Tool validation: must exist
- Duplicate check: tool can't already be in collection
- Enforces max 100 tools per collection
- Auto-calculates position if not specified
- Logs `COLLECTION_TOOL_ADDED` activity with tool name

#### **DELETE /api/collections/[id]/tools/[toolId]** (remove tool)

#### **POST /api/collections/[id]/bridge-tools** (add bridge tool)
- Similar flow for MCP bridge tools

#### **POST /api/collections/[id]/clone** (fork collection)
- Creates copy with all tools
- Optional custom name

#### **POST /api/collections/[id]/scenarios** (list/create test scenarios)

#### **POST /api/collections/[id]/use-cases/generate** (AI-generate workflows)

#### **Public API**:
- `GET /api/public/collections` - sorted by likes, recent, or tool count
- `GET /api/public/collections/[id]` - public read access

### 4. UI Components for Collections

**Location**: `/apps/web/src/components/collections/`

#### **CollectionForm.tsx**
- Create/edit collection form
- Fields: name, description, isPublic checkbox
- Client-side validation with error states
- Uses @tpmjs/ui components (no raw HTML)

#### **CollectionCard.tsx**
- Display collection in grid/list
- Shows name, description, tool count, likes

#### **CollectionList.tsx**
- Lists multiple collections
- Links to detail pages

#### **CollectionToolList.tsx**
- Lists tools within a collection
- Shows tool name, description, package name, category badge
- Optional remove button (for owners)

#### **AddToolSearch.tsx**
- Debounced search (300ms)
- Searches via `/api/tools/search?q=<query>&excludeIds=<existing>`
- Search results show: tool name, description, package, category badge
- Add button triggers `/api/collections/[id]/tools` POST
- Filters out already-added tools
- Shows category badge for each tool

#### **InstallationSection.tsx**
- How to install/use the collection

### 5. Dashboard Pages

**Location**: `/apps/web/src/app/dashboard/collections/`

#### **[id]/page.tsx** (Collection Detail)
- Tabs: Tools, Connect (MCP URL), Env Vars, Settings
- Edit collection metadata
- Add/remove tools via AddToolSearch
- Manage executor config (URL + API key)
- Manage environment variables (encrypted)
- Shows MCP URLs for different transports (stdio, sse, http)
- Clone/fork functionality
- Delete collection

### 6. How Tools are Added to Collections

**Step-by-step flow**:

1. User navigates to collection detail page
2. On "Tools" tab, AddToolSearch component appears
3. User types to search via `/api/tools/search` endpoint
4. Search API:
   - Searches tool `name`, `description`, `npmPackageName`, `npmDescription`, `npmKeywords`
   - Excludes tools already in collection via `excludeIds` param
   - Uses BM25 scoring for ranking
   - Returns top matching tools
5. User clicks "Add" button on search result
6. Request: `POST /api/collections/[id]/tools` with `{ toolId }`
7. API validates:
   - Collection exists and user owns it
   - Tool exists
   - Tool not already in collection
   - Not at max tools limit (100)
8. Creates CollectionTool entry with position
9. Updates `_count.tools` on collection
10. Logs activity `COLLECTION_TOOL_ADDED`

### 7. Tool & Package Relationship

**Key relationship structure**:

```
Package (1:n) Tool (n:m) Collection
```

**Package Model** (lines 14-55):
- `npmPackageName`: Unique identifier (e.g., "@tpmjs/tools-unsandbox")
- `npmVersion`, `npmDescription`, `npmRepository`, `npmKeywords`, etc.
- `category`: Category for filtering (e.g., "development", "data-processing")
- `frameworks`: Array of supported frameworks
- `env`: Shared environment variables across all tools in package
- `tier`: 'minimal' or 'rich' (metadata depth)
- `isOfficial`: Boolean flag for official tpmjs tools
- Relations: `tools: Tool[]` (one package has many tools)

**Tool Model** (lines 57-128):
- `packageId`: Foreign key to Package
- `name`: Tool name within package (e.g., "default", "helloWorldTool")
- `description`: What the tool does
- `inputSchema`: JSON Schema for tool parameters
- `schemaSource`: 'extracted' | 'author' | null
- Unique constraint: `[packageId, name]` (one tool per package by name)
- Relations: `collections: CollectionTool[]` (one tool can be in many collections)

**Example**:
- Package: "@tpmjs/tools-unsandbox" (59 tools in this package)
- Tools: "default", "runShell", "executeScript", etc.
- One tool from this package can appear in multiple collections

### 8. CLI Commands for Collections

**Location**: `/packages/cli/src/commands/collection/`

- `create.ts`: `tpm collection create <name>`
- `list.ts`: `tpm collection list`
- `info.ts`: `tpm collection info <id-or-slug>`
- `update.ts`: `tpm collection update <id>`
- `delete.ts`: `tpm collection delete <id>`
- `add.ts`: `tpm collection add <collection> <tool-id-1> <tool-id-2>...`
- `remove.ts`: `tpm collection remove <collection> <tool-id>`
- `import.ts`: `tpm collection import <file>`

Example: `tpm collection add my-collection tool-id-1 tool-id-2`

### 9. Collection Limits

From `/packages/types/src/collection.ts`:
- **50 collections** per user
- **100 tools** per collection
- **50 bridge tools** per collection
- 100 chars for name
- 500 chars for description
- 500 chars for tool notes

### 10. Key Features

1. **Public/Private**: Collections can be made public for sharing
2. **Forking**: Users can fork collections (creates copy with all tools)
3. **Executor Configuration**: Collections specify how tools execute (railway, vercel, etc.)
4. **Environment Variables**: Encrypted env vars per collection
5. **AI-Generated Content**: Automatic use cases and skills documentation
6. **Activity Tracking**: User actions logged for activity feeds
7. **MCP Integration**: Collections expose tools via MCP protocol (stdio, SSE, HTTP)
8. **Bridge Tools**: Support for real-time tools from Claude Desktop
9. **Slugs**: URL-friendly identifiers unique per user

## TPMJS Tracking & Analytics Infrastructure - Comprehensive Report

Based on my thorough exploration of the codebase, here's the complete tracking and analytics infrastructure:

---

### 1. **DATABASE SCHEMA - TRACKING TABLES** 
*(packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma)*

#### A. **Page View Tracking**
- **Table**: `PageView` (lines 346-358)
- **Purpose**: Daily-bucketed view counts for tools, collections, and agents
- **Fields**: 
  - `entityType` (tool | collection | agent)
  - `entityId` (ID of entity)
  - `viewCount` (daily count)
  - `date` (UTC Date bucket)
- **Deduplication**: 1 view per entity per IP per hour (in-memory)

#### B. **Simulation/Execution Tracking**
- **Table**: `Simulation` (lines 161-195)
  - Tracks tool playground executions
  - Fields: `userPrompt`, `parameters`, `status` (pending|running|success|error|timeout), `executionTimeMs`, `output`, `error`, `agentSteps`, `model`
  - Relations: `tokenUsage`, `logs`, `ipAddress` (for rate limiting)

- **Table**: `TokenUsage` (lines 198-213)
  - Per-simulation token consumption tracking
  - Fields: `inputTokens`, `toolDescTokens`, `schemaTokens`, `outputTokens`, `totalTokens`, `estimatedCost`

- **Table**: `ExecutionLog` (lines 216-230)
  - Detailed logs for each simulation
  - Fields: `level` (info|warning|error|debug), `event`, `message`, `metadata`

#### C. **API Usage Tracking** (NEW)
- **Table**: `TpmjsApiKey` (lines 1048-1083)
  - User API keys with scopes and rate limits
  - Fields: `name`, `keyHash`, `keyPrefix`, `scopes`, `rateLimit`, `isActive`, `lastUsedAt`, `expiresAt`

- **Table**: `ApiUsageRecord` (lines 1086-1124)
  - Individual API request logs (kept 30 days)
  - Fields: `endpoint`, `method`, `statusCode`, `latencyMs`, `resourceType`, `resourceId`, `tokensIn`, `tokensOut`, `model`, `errorCode`, `errorMessage`, `userAgent`, `ipAddress`

- **Table**: `ApiUsageSummary` (lines 1127-1168)
  - Hourly/daily/monthly aggregated usage summaries
  - Fields: `periodType`, `periodStart`, `totalRequests`, `successRequests`, `errorRequests`, `endpointCounts` (JSON), `totalTokensIn`, `totalTokensOut`, `avgLatencyMs`, `estimatedCostCents`

#### D. **Health Check Tracking**
- **Table**: `HealthCheck` (lines 233-266)
  - Full audit history of tool health checks
  - Fields: `checkType` (IMPORT|EXECUTION|FULL), `triggerSource` (sync|manual|daily-cron), `importStatus`, `executionStatus`, `overallStatus`

#### E. **Daily Statistics Snapshot**
- **Table**: `StatsSnapshot` (lines 283-344)
  - Daily snapshot of registry statistics for historical tracking
  - Fields: `totalTools`, `totalPackages`, `executionsTotal`, `executionsSuccessful`, `executionsFailed`, `executionsAvgTimeMs`, `tokensInput`, `tokensOutput`, `tokensTotal`, `tokensCostUsd`, `healthChecksRun`, `activeDevs7d`, `totalCollections`, `totalAgents`, `totalSimulations`

#### F. **Scenario Execution Tracking**
- **Table**: `ScenarioRun` (lines 1237-1282)

1→import { z } from 'zod';
     2→
     3→import { ExecutorTypeSchema } from './executor';
     4→
     5→// Regex for valid collection names: letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, underscores
     6→const NAME_REGEX = /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\-_]+$/;
     7→
     8→// Executor config for updates (simplified schema that maps to database JSON)
     9→const ExecutorConfigUpdateSchema = z
    10→  .object({
    11→    url: z.string().url(),
    12→    apiKey: z.string().optional(),
    13→  })
    14→  .nullable()
    15→  .optional();
    16→
    17→// ============================================================================
    18→// Collection Schemas
    19→// ============================================================================
    20→
    21→export const CreateCollectionSchema = z.object({
    22→  name: z
    23→    .string()
    24→    .min(1, 'Name is required')
    25→    .max(100, 'Name must be 100 characters or less')
    26→    .regex(NAME_REGEX, 'Name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores'),
    27→  description: z.string().max(500, 'Description must be 500 characters or less').optional(),
    28→  isPublic: z.boolean().default(false),
    29→});
    30→
    31→export const UpdateCollectionSchema = z.object({
    32→  name: z
    33→    .string()
    34→    .min(1, 'Name is required')
    35→    .max(100, 'Name must be 100 characters or less')
    36→    .regex(NAME_REGEX, 'Name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores')
    37→    .optional(),
    38→  description: z
    39→    .string()
    40→    .max(500, 'Description must be 500 characters or less')
    41→    .nullable()
    42→    .optional(),
    43→  isPublic: z.boolean().optional(),
    44→  // Executor configuration
    45→  executorType: ExecutorTypeSchema.nullable().optional(),
    46→  executorConfig: ExecutorConfigUpdateSchema,
    47→  // Tool environment variables
    48→  envVars: z.record(z.string(), z.string()).nullable().optional(),
    49→});
    50→
    51→// ============================================================================
    52→// Collection Tool Schemas
    53→// ============================================================================
    54→
    55→export const AddToolToCollectionSchema = z.object({
    56→  toolId: z.string().min(1, 'Tool ID is required'),
    57→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').optional(),
    58→  position: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
    59→});
    60→
    61→export const UpdateCollectionToolSchema = z.object({
    62→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').nullable().optional(),
    63→  position: z.number().int().min(0).optional(),
    64→});
    65→
    66→export const ReorderToolsSchema = z.object({
    67→  toolIds: z.array(z.string().min(1)),
    68→});
    69→
    70→// ============================================================================
    71→// Bridge Tool Schemas
    72→// ============================================================================
    73→
    74→export const AddBridgeToolToCollectionSchema = z.object({
    75→  serverId: z.string().min(1, 'Server ID is required').max(100),
    76→  toolName: z.string().min(1, 'Tool name is required').max(100),
    77→  displayName: z.string().max(100).optional(),
    78→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').optional(),
    79→});
    80→
    81→export const UpdateCollectionBridgeToolSchema = z.object({
    82→  displayName: z.string().max(100).nullable().optional(),
    83→  note: z.string().max(500, 'Note must be 500 characters or less').nullable().optional(),
    84→});
    85→
    86→// ============================================================================
    87→// Clone Schemas
    88→// ============================================================================
    89→
    90→export const CloneCollectionSchema = z.object({
    91→  name: z
    92→    .string()
    93→    .min(1, 'Name is required')
    94→    .max(100, 'Name must be 100 characters or less')
    95→    .regex(NAME_REGEX, 'Name can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores')
    96→    .optional(), // If not provided, will use original name or append "(copy)"
    97→});
    98→
    99→// ============================================================================
   100→// Use Case Types (AI-generated workflows)
   101→// ============================================================================
   102→
   103→export const UseCaseToolStepSchema = z.object({
   104→  toolName: z.string().describe('Name of the tool being invoked'),
   105→  packageName: z.string().describe('NPM package name containing the tool'),
   106→  purpose: z.string().max(100).describe('Why this tool is called at this step'),
   107→  order: z.number().int().min(1).describe('Execution order (1-based)'),
   108→});
   109→
   110→export const UseCaseSchema = z.object({
   111→  id: z.string().describe('Unique identifier for this use case'),
   112→  userPrompt: z
   113→    .string()
   114→    .min(20)
   115→    .max(200)
   116→    .describe('Example user prompt that triggers this workflow'),
   117→  description: z.string().min(30).max(150).describe('Brief description of what this accomplishes'),
   118→  toolSequence: z
   119→    .array(UseCaseToolStepSchema)
   120→    .min(1)
   121→    .max(10)
   122→    .describe('Ordered sequence of tool calls'),
   123→});
   124→
   125→export const CollectionUseCasesSchema = z.array(UseCaseSchema).max(6);
   126→
   127→export type UseCaseToolStep = z.infer<typeof UseCaseToolStepSchema>;
   128→export type UseCase = z.infer<typeof UseCaseSchema>;
   129→export type CollectionUseCases = z.infer<typeof CollectionUseCasesSchema>;
   130→
   131→// ============================================================================
   132→// Response Types (for API responses)
   133→// ============================================================================
   134→
   135→export const CollectionSchema = z.object({
   136→  id: z.string(),
   137→  name: z.string(),
   138→  slug: z.string().nullable(),
   139→  description: z.string().nullable(),
   140→  isPublic: z.boolean(),
   141→  toolCount: z.number(),
   142→  forkCount: z.number().default(0),
   143→  forkedFromId: z.string().nullable().optional(),
   144→  useCases: CollectionUseCasesSchema.nullable().optional(),
   145→  useCasesGeneratedAt: z.date().nullable().optional(),
   146→  createdAt: z.date(),
   147→  updatedAt: z.date(),
   148→});
   149→
   150→export const CollectionToolSchema = z.object({
   151→  id: z.string(),
   152→  toolId: z.string(),
   153→  position: z.number(),
   154→  note: z.string().nullable(),
   155→  addedAt: z.date(),
   156→  tool: z.object({
   157→    id: z.string(),
   158→    name: z.string(),
   159→    description: z.string(),
   160→    package: z.object({
   161→      id: z.string(),
   162→      npmPackageName: z.string(),
   163→      category: z.string(),
   164→    }),
   165→  }),
   166→});
   167→
   168→export const CollectionWithToolsSchema = CollectionSchema.extend({
   169→  tools: z.array(CollectionToolSchema),
   170→});
   171→
   172→// ============================================================================
   173→// Type Exports
   174→// ============================================================================
   175→
   176→export type CreateCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof CreateCollectionSchema>;
   177→export type UpdateCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof UpdateCollectionSchema>;
   178→export type AddToolToCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof AddToolToCollectionSchema>;
   179→export type UpdateCollectionToolInput = z.infer<typeof UpdateCollectionToolSchema>;
   180→export type ReorderToolsInput = z.infer<typeof ReorderToolsSchema>;
   181→export type CloneCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof CloneCollectionSchema>;
   182→export type AddBridgeToolToCollectionInput = z.infer<typeof AddBridgeToolToCollectionSchema>;
   183→export type UpdateCollectionBridgeToolInput = z.infer<typeof UpdateCollectionBridgeToolSchema>;
   184→export type Collection = z.infer<typeof CollectionSchema>;
   185→export type CollectionTool = z.infer<typeof CollectionToolSchema>;
   186→export type CollectionWithTools = z.infer<typeof CollectionWithToolsSchema>;
   187→
   188→// ============================================================================
   189→// Constants
   190→// ============================================================================
   191→
   192→export const COLLECTION_LIMITS = {
   193→  MAX_COLLECTIONS_PER_USER: 50,
   194→  MAX_TOOLS_PER_COLLECTION: 100,
   195→  MAX_BRIDGE_TOOLS_PER_COLLECTION: 50,
   196→  MAX_NAME_LENGTH: 100,
   197→  MAX_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH: 500,

    14→/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
    15→model Package {

    18→  // NPM Metadata

    22→  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
